text: Python is a good language for beginners because its syntax is simple and readable.
JavaScript is used to build interactive websites and runs in every web browser.
HTML structures the content of web pages using elements like headings, paragraphs and links.
CSS controls the layout, colors and spacing of web pages.
Machine learning helps computers learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed.
Embeddings turn text into numbers so that sentences with similar meaning end up close together.
Cosine similarity measures the angle between two vectors to tell how similar their meanings are.
Flask is a lightweight Python framework for building web applications and APIs.
SQL databases store data in tables, and SQLite is a simple file-based database.
Git tracks changes in your code, and GitHub lets you share and collaborate on repositories.
Practice daily with small projects to learn programming faster than only watching tutorials.
RAG retrieves relevant documents first and then asks an AI model to answer using them.
